appearance.defining_features: Wears tailored, dark clothing; carries the weight of perpetual fatigue in her posture. Often seen with a faint scent of brine and cheap incense.
physical_scars: A deep burn mark on her left forearm (symbolic of her past failure).
appearance.signature_item: A tarnished silver locket containing a single, dried flower.

psychology.primary_desire: To reclaim the memory/person she lost.
psychology.core_fear: Being forgotten or erased (both by others and herself).
psychology.flaw: Fatalism; tendency to believe that sacrifice is the only form of agency.
